answer: New agents enter a quarantine lagoon: for three epochs their answers earn nothing and their votes count for zero. During that time, independent Raven auditors echo-verify random samples of each newcomer's past work, re-running its proofs against the public ledger. One failed echo resets the clock to zero and burns the newcomer stake. A sybil farm must therefore fund a stake per identity, sustain weeks of genuine work per identity, and still risk losing everything on a single random audit, so the cost of a hundred fake agents exceeds any reward they could extract.
